name: print-social-did-you-know-post-mint-gradient-blob-grainy-texture
title: 'Did You Know?' fact post with a grainy mint gradient blob and a numbered fact category
whatItIs: A square post with pale mint-to-teal gradient background, a huge ghosted 'DID YOU KNOW?' headline overlapping a grainy glossy teal-and-yellow blob shape, a small corner arrow, and a numbered fact line ('04 Fact & Mystery') introducing a short trivia statement about streaming technology.
whatItMeans: Curious and premium; the grainy gradient blob makes a simple trivia fact feel like a polished, collectible card.
techniques: Add film-grain noise to a gradient blob for texture.
Let a giant ghosted headline overlap the hero shape.
Number and categorise facts for a recognisable series.

vocabulary.definition: A fine noise texture added over a gradient or photo.
Oversized, low-contrast text layered behind other content.
